story.title: City seeks input on 2025-26 federal housing funds
story.summary: The City of Fort Worth is inviting residents to review and provide comments on its 2025-26 Consolidated Annual Performance and Evaluation Report (CAPER), which details how federal funding is being used to support affordable housing, improve living conditions and expand economic opportunities for residents with low and moderate incomes. Each year, the City receives federal grant funds from the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) to support housing and community development initiatives. Through the annual CAPER, the City reports to residents and HUD on how and where these funds are spent, who administers the programs and how the funding benefits the community.
